stops.note: Malay for any boat; sailing craft with outriggers linked the islands from Malacca to the Philippines
reached English via Portuguese parao and Dutch prauw, and was also applied to Micronesian craft: George Anson's crew captured a 'flying proa' at Tinian in 1742 and marvelled at its speed

current_meaning: a fast Malay or Micronesian sailing boat with an outrigger
